value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Mountain View/Santa Clara County.

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

value.name: Photovoltaic (PV) System Installation handout materials (Single-Family Residential or Multifamily/Commercial version, required for the ePermitsMV non-SolarAPP+ pathway)
Proof of Mountain View business license and valid California contractor's license
SolarAPP+ approved permit (retained on-site during installation)

value: For SolarAPP+ permits: one business day after SolarAPP+ approval, the City emails the contractor a Mountain View inspection permit number, which is used to schedule the inspection online
For ePermitsMV (non-SolarAPP+) permits: schedule the inspection online using the Mountain View permit number after fee payment and permit issuance
Code design and installation practices are verified by a City Building Inspector at a site inspection, scheduled by the contractor at least one business day after permit approval

value.notes: SolarAPP+-eligible single-family permits are automatically issued instantly ('The online program will verify compliance...and automatically issue a permit'). Other solar permits submitted via ePermitsMV receive corrections/comments within 3 business days (single-family) or 5 business days (all other properties).

other_conditions: SolarAPP+ covers roof-mounted or building-integrated PV on single-family homes, with or without energy storage or an electrical service panel upgrade
Other solar installations (multifamily, commercial, industrial, or single-family projects not covered by SolarAPP+) go through the city's ePermitsMV system instead
